metadata.description: The Motir plugin: skills that let a coding agent work a Motir project and the Motir MCP server they reach it through (signed into in the browser).

plugins.name: motir
plugins.description: Run the next Motir card end to end, repair a card's red pull requests, carry on a dead run on the branch it left, log a verified bug, clear the Bugs folder, close a manual card, be guided through one step by step, and review a card's pull requests with your own agent. Connects the Motir MCP (signed into in the browser).
